_about: NRTL parameters fitted inside the MHV1 mixing rule (PSRK form) of SRK and Peng-Robinson to the open high-pressure data of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive, by validation/fit_mhv1_high_pressure.mjs (proposal 0018; the maintainer, 2026-11-06). tau_ij = a_ij + b_ij / T (b in K), G_ij = exp(-alpha tau_ij); i, j in the order given. Used only by SRK/PR + gE (MHV1), not by the activity models.

source.fit: Fitted for CHEPTA with validation/fit_mhv1_high_pressure.mjs inside the MHV1 rule of SRK to the 27 bubble pressures of 1 article of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (each article the same total weight), 298.15-372.9 K, 241.5-3232.2 kPa: AAD 2.7 % in P (max 7.7 %), gas solubility at the measured T and P AAD 2.8 % (max 8.4 %)

Fitted for CHEPTA with validation/fit_mhv1_high_pressure.mjs inside the MHV1 rule of PR to the 27 bubble pressures of 1 article of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (each article the same total weight), 298.15-372.9 K, 241.5-3232.2 kPa: AAD 2.6 % in P (max 7.5 %), gas solubility at the measured T and P AAD 2.8 % (max 8.1 %)
